title: The tolerant learning hierarchy for c.e. sets
summary: Learning from positive data models a scenario in which a learner receives longer and longer initial segments of an enumeration of an unknown set and repeatedly outputs a conjecture about it. Classical identification in the limit requires the learner to eventually stabilise to a hypothesis naming the target exactly, while anomalous learning relaxes this requirement by allowing finitely many errors in the final hypothesis.
